Container.Name: kanban
Container.Overview:
A small Kanban board: boards with columns and WIP limits, cards with labels, due dates, assignees, checklists and comments, drag and drop, search, dark mode. One static Go binary, HTML rendered by the server, and no Node runtime anywhere near it.
With STORAGE=sqlite the whole board is one file under /data and there is nothing else to install. STORAGE=postgres points it at a PostgreSQL container instead, with DB_HOST and the DB_* variables below.
Snapshots: with BACKUP_DIR set the server writes one JSON file with every board on a timer and keeps the last BACKUP_KEEP of them. `kanban import` reads one back, on either backend.
The board has no sign-in of its own: whoever reaches the port can change every card. Keep it on the LAN, or put something that authenticates in front of it and set AUTH_MODE=proxy.
There is no shell in the image. To see what the container thinks its configuration is, run: docker exec kanban /kanban doctor

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: The port the board listens on.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Holds the SQLite file and the snapshots. Back this up.

Config.Name: Storage backend
Config.Description: sqlite, postgres or memory. memory keeps nothing.

Config.Name: Snapshot directory
Config.Description: Where the timed snapshots go. Empty turns them off.

Config.Name: Snapshot interval
Config.Description: Gap between snapshots, as 24h or 30m. 0 turns the schedule off.

Config.Name: Snapshots to keep
Config.Description: Older ones are deleted after a successful write. 0 keeps every one.

Config.Name: Database host
Config.Description: STORAGE=postgres only. The container or host name of PostgreSQL.

Config.Name: Identity mode
Config.Description: none, or proxy when something in front of the board authenticates and sets the header named in AUTH_HEADER.

Config.Name: Identity header
Config.Description: AUTH_MODE=proxy only. The header the proxy sets, which the board reads as the caller.

Config.Name: Avatars
Config.Description: address=github-login pairs, comma separated. Unset draws initials and makes no outbound request.
